mapper.insert: INSERT INTO station (name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{metro}, #{city}, #{rapidCnt}, #{slowCnt}, #{carType}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude FROM station
SELECT id, name, address, metro, city, rapid_cnt, slow_cnt, car_type, latitude, longitude FROM station WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station WHERE address = #{address}
